input.command:
cd catalog && sed -i 's/Book(title.strip(), author.strip(), year.strip(), int(copies))/Book(title.strip(), author.strip(), int(year), int(copies))/' books.py \
&& sed -i 's/from catalog.nonexistent import normalize/from catalog.text import normalize/' search.py \
&& sed -i 's/round(days_late + DAILY_FEE, 2)/round(days_late * DAILY_FEE, 2)/' fees.py \
&& sed -i 's/self._history\[-n - 1:\]/self._history[-n:]/' inventory.py \
&& sed -i 's/MAX_BORROWED = 3/MAX_BORROWED = 5/' members.py \
&& sed -i 's/        Book("1984", "Orwell", 1949, 2),/&\n        Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1),/' factory.py \
&& cd .. && python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -5
